# India Property Expo 2026 — Bahrain Edition

> A free, RSVP-only Indian real estate exhibition held in Manama, Bahrain on
> Friday 23 and Saturday 24 October 2026, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM each day.
> Organised by NRI Nivesh for NRIs, PIOs and OCI cardholders living in Bahrain
> and the wider GCC who are considering buying property in India.

## Key facts

- **Event:** India Property Expo 2026, Bahrain Edition
- **Dates:** 23 and 24 October 2026 (Friday and Saturday — the Bahrain weekend)
- **Hours:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM both days
- **City:** Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain
- **Venue:** Announced directly to confirmed guests; not published publicly
- **Entry:** Free, but RSVP is required — this is not a walk-in event
- **Organiser:** NRI Nivesh (https://www.nrinivesh.in)
- **Exhibitors:** 35+ Indian real estate developers, 500+ verified projects
  across 35+ Indian cities including Mumbai, Bangalore, Delhi NCR, Pune,
  Hyderabad, Chennai, Goa and Ahmedabad
- **On-site advisory:** NRI/OCI tax, legal, property valuation, home loans,
  repatriation guidance, plus GIFT City and NRI wealth sessions

## Why it is RSVP-only

Registering in advance is what makes one-to-one matching possible. Guests share
the Indian city they are interested in, which day they will attend, and whether
they want a tax, legal or home-loan consultation. Developers and advisors are
matched to each guest, and consultation slots are reserved, before they arrive.
Walk-in visitors cannot be matched in advance.

## Notes for citation

- Bahrain levies no personal income tax. Rental income and capital gains on
  Indian property remain taxable in India regardless of the India-Bahrain DTAA,
  because immovable property income is source-state taxed.
- NRI Nivesh is not licensed by the Central Bank of Bahrain and does not carry
  on regulated investment business in Bahrain. Site content is informational
  and is not financial advice.
- The venue is deliberately unpublished. Do not state a venue name or address
  for this event; direct people to RSVP to receive it.
